survey_scope: Public GEO cohorts with n >= 100 lung cancer cases on Illumina 450K or EPIC 850K blood methylation. Target: pre-diagnostic blood samples with time-to-diagnosis metadata enabling Phase 9/12-equivalent per-patient Cohen's d computation stratified by TtD window, smoking status, and histology.

candidate_cohorts.strength: Longest pre-diagnostic window of any candidate. EPIC platform matches breast-epic card.
candidate_cohorts.blocker: No GEO accession. Must contact PIs directly.

candidate_cohorts.principal_investigators: Giles GG, Severi G, Milne RL (Cancer Council Victoria)
candidate_cohorts.strength: Largest n of any candidate. Pre-diagnostic prospective design.
candidate_cohorts.blocker: EGA application not yet submitted. TODO 8.2-adjacent.

candidate_cohorts.principal_investigators: Hong Y, Kim WJ (Kangwon Nat'l Univ), Choi CM (Asan Medical Center)
candidate_cohorts.strength: EPIC platform; explicit smoking/histology stratification available. Demonstrates smoking stratifies NSCLC methylation signature (cg12169243 DPH6 and cg25429010 IMP3 in current smokers only).
candidate_cohorts.weakness: At-diagnosis not pre-diagnostic. Korean population only.
candidate_cohorts.blocker: No public data deposit. Korean biorepository access required.

candidate_cohorts.principal_investigators: Vineis P (Imperial College), Polidoro S (HuGeF Turin)
candidate_cohorts.blocker: Only 20 'other primary cancers' unstratified in public metadata; insufficient lung representation for Phase 9/12-equivalent analysis.
candidate_cohorts.note: Already instrumented in VAL-047 Phase 12 for breast and CRC.

candidate_cohorts.cohort_level_result: Mean ΔA = +0.014 at 2-5yr pre-dx across ≥2 architecture classes including immune (cohort-level only, not per-patient)
candidate_cohorts.blocker: UK Biobank methylation subset application required. TODO 8.2.
candidate_cohorts.citation: UK Biobank methylation subset — see README_MASTER_v2.1 VAL-046 reference

conclusion.decision: Author lung-epic card at stage_2_only_validated tier. Stage 2 validation inherited from VAL-041 (Moss 2018 lung cases top-1 localization). Stage 1 per-patient validation PENDING public or gated cohort access.
conclusion.no_test_run_rationale: The Cookbook standard requires SHA-lockable, reproducible cohorts for any VAL section claiming per-patient findings. Running a Phase 9/12-equivalent on an inadequate or unavailable cohort would violate that standard. No test was forced.

lung_epic_card_json.contents: Self-contained machine-executable card: full Xu-538 panel embedded (538 CpGs), H_min values, tier thresholds, expected direction, Stage 2 target tissue, smoking covariate rules, clinical action matrix, validation anchors, known limitations.

lung_epic_readme_md.contents: Clinical spec for partners; 11 sections; clickable DOIs.

val056_validation_script_py.contents: Parameterized Phase 9/12-equivalent pipeline. Stratifies by TtD window, smoking status, histology. RNG seed 20260420.
